item.title: Ganesan | What Stanford students really do at Coupa Cafe
item.description: Columnist Avani Ganesan considers the time-honored coffee chat. "The more strategically we approach connection, the less likely we are to find it," she writes. The post Ganesan | What Stanford students really do at Coupa Cafe appeared first on The Stanford Daily.

item.title: Students with OAE accommodations blocked from forming roommate groups under new housing rules
item.description: Students with disabilities or religious accommodations will be unable to extend their housing priorities to others for the 2026-27 academic year. Rising sophomores will have the latest gate times for general housing selection. The post Students with OAE accommodations blocked from forming roommate groups under new housing rules appeared first on The Stanford Daily.
